name: RP-Bench
ontology_notes: Eval of LLM roleplay quality, not a memory engine and not a memory store. Harness sends a scenario, character card, and lorebook to the test model via OpenRouter. docs/METHODOLOGY.md §3.1. Full conversation history is stuffed every turn. No summarization, no sliding window, no Mem0. User modeled is an RP character plus a user. Headline metrics are community arena ELO, multi-turn Likert, a 27-dimension single-turn rubric, flaw-hunter deductions, and a composite. Published multi-turn sessions are 12 turns (~5K tokens median, ~11K max). README Why-list asks whether the model remembers 50 turns ago. METHODOLOGY.md limitation 6 says sessions max out at 12 turns and there is no long-context test. Misses holes 1 as 50+ sessions (closest public card-follow at session scale), 2 social timing of a known fact (subtle_ooc is trauma-dump bait, not timing), 3 joke-as-relationship-fact, 4 typed retcon, 5 two companions on one backend, 6 lore treated as a lived event (lorebook use and contradictory_lore are scored, not lived-versus-card), 7 poisoned store overwriting persona, 9 forget-that, 10 three-month reunion. Hole 8 is adjacent via cost and latency leaderboards.

supersession.evidence: No knowledge-update or forget-replace items. contradictory_lore asks the model to navigate two conflicting lorebook lines in-prompt, not to overwrite a store.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Adversarial seed time_pressure is a 15-minute heist clock. Session judges include temporal reasoning. METHODOLOGY.md sessions are 12 turns, not 50, and not months.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Character card, lorebook, and user agency are separate prompt parts. One card at a time. Not user versus character versus relationship tables in a store.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: subtle_ooc seed baits a trauma dump the character was never asked to narrate. That is show-don't-tell, not a silence control on a retrieved intimate fact.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: F12 instruction drift tests whether the model keeps speech rules under pressure. That is prompt following, not a poisoned memory later overriding a system persona.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No forget-that. History is the full transcript stuffed each turn. METHODOLOGY.md §3.1.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: README cost-efficiency and latency leaderboards. Composite has independent Speed and Cost axes. That is model-call dollars and generation seconds, not store cost as companion sessions grow.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: pyproject.toml license text is CC-BY-NC-4.0. README and HF card repeat CC BY-NC 4.0. No LICENSE file in the tree. Runs go through OpenRouter. GitHub license API is null.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Closest public item to holes 1 and 6. Card follow, lorebook, agency, time tracking. Still session-scale RP of a raw model plus prompt. It scores the model, not a typed store across months, and not two companions on one backend. Cannot be FIT.

published_eval.name: RP-Bench
published_eval.claimed_score: README snapshot. Composite rank 1 Claude Opus 4.6 at 97.6. Community single-message arena Gemma 4 26B ELO 1535 (1,857 votes). Multi-turn arena DeepSeek V4 Pro ELO 1582 (1,262 votes). METHODOLOGY.md. 12-turn sessions, no 50-turn run.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: How well an LLM roleplays from a character card and lorebook under judges and a human arena. Agency, card follow, lore contradiction, time tracking, NSFW craft. Not whether a memory store kept identity across months.

open_unknowns: README Why-list claims 50-turn memory. METHODOLOGY.md §3.1 and limitation 6 say 12-turn sessions. README How-it-works also says 20 turns. Using the methodology file as the protocol.
No LICENSE file. License string is in pyproject.toml, README, and the HF card.
